# Additional mode-3 runtime audit (not implemented or measured)

The sampled busy worker has about 11% self samples in find_original. Existing outlined lookup is the next independent test after literal fusion.

A separate static lead: lookup_compiled_impl still writes cpu->aot_code_begin/end for every ROM/RAM entry, although mode 3 generated code omits their readers. aot_runtime.cpp lines 212, 223-224, 238-239; emitted readers in arm_translator.cpp are under skip_code_write_guards conditions. These writes have not been isolated in timing, so no speed estimate or change is warranted yet. A future experiment should select a templated guard-publication path once per runner, retain compatibility mode 0, verification callbacks and any alternate-policy tests, and prove no reader needs the fields before suppressing them. Do not add a test to each generated store. No mapping or lifetime check is implicated.

No build started, no source edit, no change to current frozen timing plan.

Additional audit after literal-PC delivery: normal mode-3 counters reproduce the earlier 9.11/9.05m region-entry reduction, with slightly lower compiled instruction coverage and negligible net WASM-heap changes. Those effects are separately recorded in MODE3_LITERAL_RESULTS.md; the old module byte-size result remains mode0 only.

For any guard-publication experiment, inspect the startup ROM emission path and every reader of AOT_CODE_BEGIN/END, not just RAM stores. Mode is frozen before CPU initialization, but precompiled/alternate-policy exports and verification callbacks must be considered explicitly. Prefer one runner-level selection of a templated lookup/runner path; do not add an experimental branch to each generated store. Preserve mapping-source, generation, ASID, liveness, permissions and fault behavior. Retain explicit mode0 publication and a same-binary control. This remains a static lead, not implemented or approved as a measured speedup.

2026-10-01 follow-up audit while outlined-lookup timings run:
- All production AOT_CODE_BEGIN/END loads occur in arm_translator.cpp scalar writes, IR guarded_host, write-span entry proofs, block stores, or census overlap capture; each is suppressed by skip_code_write_guards(). No Thumb reader exists.
- Startup ROM exports (system/src/aot_setup.cpp), hot ROM/RAM translations and profile-guided Thumb modules are generated after the pre-initialization policy selection. stage_aot_module is used by these internal producers; no separate persisted generated-module cache was found in these paths.
- Validation callbacks and ordinary C++ code do not read the two fields. Detailed census uses the cache entry pointer for dependency metadata, not these state slots.
- A bounded candidate can template publication in lookup/runner, select once per runner, and omit it only when an independent opt-in switch AND skip_code_write_guards() are true. Modes 0/1 must retain publication even with the switch selected. All mapping/generation/ASID/liveness validation stays intact.
- Required focused test: real lookup/runner with sentinel guard fields, both switches, all unsafe modes, normal/detailed runners, budgets/stop/IRQ, and a synthetic function that checks each lookup publication. This checks removal rather than merely matching guest output.
- Added cost: additional runner specializations/static module bytes and one choice at the outer entry. Measure those and full gameplay rather than assuming two omitted stores help. This is pending the lookup result; no compiler build or source mutation ran during that panel.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,time,re
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'guard-publication-candidate'
def phase(name,**kw):
 (s/'guard-publication-acceptance-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
e=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='0',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='0')

 with(s/name).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 print(name+' PASS',flush=True)
try:
 phase('waiting_for_compiler_suite')
 start=time.time()
 while '176 passed, 0 failed' not in (s/'guard-publication-suite.log').read_text():

 phase('native_faults')
 # This probe tests generated instructions/callbacks, not the publication selector.
 # Dedicated real-runner tests and selected browser replays cover that selector.
 run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/run_cpu_fault_matrix.py',str(a),str(s/'guard-publication-fault'),'--ir-policy','7','--code-compare','2','--tlb-hash','1','--execution-limits','512,16,8,512','--predicated-leaves','1','--exit-census','0','--leaf-features','128','--code-lookup','0','--unsafe-code','3','--literal-pc-veneers'],'guard-publication-fault.log')
 q=json.loads((s/'guard-publication-fault/summary.json').read_text());assert q['completed_cases']==46016 and all(x['all_fields_match']==x['cases']for x in q['results'])
 for mode,omit,verify,scene in [(3,1,0,'standard'),(3,1,0,'long'),(3,0,0,'standard'),(3,0,0,'long'),(3,1,1024,'standard'),(3,1,1024,'long'),(0,1,0,'standard')]:
  label=f'{scene}-m{mode}-o{omit}-v{verify}'

  frames,start,route,ref,pcm=(1600,21000000,'snakes.input','merge-20260930-native',4656051)if scene=='standard'else(360,42000000,'snakes-length-long.input','merge-20260930-long-native',2832756)
  out=s/f'guard-publication-replay-{label}'
  env=dict(e,EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE=str(mode),EKA2L1_OMIT_GUARD_PUBLICATION=str(omit),EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY=str(verify))
  run(['node','benchmark.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),str(frames),str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route),str(start)],f'guard-publication-replay-{label}.log',r/'src/tests/wasm',env)
  run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/compare.py',str(s/ref/'run-0/frames'),str(out)],f'guard-publication-compare-{label}.json')
  c=json.loads((s/f'guard-publication-compare-{label}.json').read_text());assert c['match']and c['frames']==frames and c['audio']['sample_frames']==pcm

 phase('acceptance_complete')
 (s/'guard-publication-acceptance-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(accepted=True,archive=str(a),mode=3,features=128,lookup=0)))
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise
